entities.summary: Nina Franke is a Dutch sprinter and hurdler. She was runner-up in the 400 metres hurdles at the Dutch Athletics Championships in 2024 and a gold medalist at the 2025 European Athletics Indoor Championships and a silver medalist at the 2026 World Indoor Championships in the women's 4 × 400 metres relay.
